notes.title: Game Markdown
notes.content:
Hello from Dr. Loveless and ANTIMEDIA-GAMES. 

Thank you for the patience while we prohibitively marketed this game at $18.99. 

The game has been marked down to a price closer to what the organization desires for their titles going forward after some business executives and myself 'had it out' with the market and our own outlook. 

We look forward to you enjoying our smaller batch titles like this one, "Fall of Mankind".
